shortDescription: Insert a single record into an SQLite database table.

options.name: alter
options.description: If set, missing columns will be added automatically.

options.name: column_order
options.description: Specifies a full or partial column order to use when creating the table.

options.name: columns
options.description: Dictionary overriding the detected types used for columns.

options.name: conversions
options.description: Dictionary specifying SQL conversion functions to apply to data during insertion.

options.name: db_path
options.description: Path to the SQLite database. Ensure the database file is accessible and writable.

options.name: defaults
options.description: Specifies default values for specific columns.

options.name: extracts
options.description: List of columns to extract to other tables, or a dictionary that maps column names to other table names.

options.name: hash_id
options.description: Name of a column to create and use as a primary key, with its value derived as a SHA1 hash of other column values in the record.

options.name: ignore
options.description: If a record with the same primary key already exists, the insertion will be ignored.

options.name: not_null
options.description: Specifies columns that should be NOT NULL.

options.name: pk
options.description: Specifies which column should be the primary key when creating the table.

options.name: records
options.description: The record to insert into the table, represented as a dictionary.

options.name: replace
options.description: If a record with the same primary key already exists, it will be replaced.

options.name: table
options.description: Name of the table to insert data into.
